zh.name: 一页一图解速查
zh.summary: 把一套机制拆成有明确关系的图解，用连接、分支或流程帮助读者查询。
zh.useWhen: 关系不限定同心层级，区别于现有三层结构拆解；同一系统的不同图解合并。
zh.instructions: 实体、关系、真实输入输出、一个贯穿例子
zh.output: 一组保留本模板风格、叙事与钩子的 Instagram 图文。

en.name: Diagram Reference Cards
en.summary: Create an Instagram reference carousel using the diagram reference cards structure. Preserve its visual hierarchy, sequence and opening payoff.
en.useWhen: Use when your content needs the diagram reference cards format.
en.instructions: Provide your topic, audience, usable source material and confirmed facts.
en.output: An editable Instagram carousel with this template’s sequence and visual style.

imageCues: 奶油白底，顶部紧缩粗体标题54–66px，关键词蓝/绿
中央是占70–80%高度的原生关系图：框28–38px、连接线2–3px、箭头与分支标签准确
底部一行解释/来源，不放装饰性大插图
